collection.title: Mazda Mazda6e 2026 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mazda 6e Estate 2026 Onwards model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Notched Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
